welcome:
👋 Welcome to the Saya bot!

This bot lets you chat anonymously and securely with strangers.

Press the button below to complete registration and get started.
welcome_back:
👋 Welcome back, {nickname}!

Ready to chat with someone anonymous?
reg_nickname: Please choose a nickname (2 to 30 characters):
reg_nickname_invalid:
❌ Invalid nickname. It must be 2-30 characters with letters, numbers and spaces only.

Try again:
reg_age_invalid:
❌ Invalid age. Must be a number between 13 and 120.

Try again:
reg_country: Enter your country code (e.g. US, GB, DE):
reg_country_invalid:
❌ Invalid country code. Must be two letters.

Try again:
reg_bio: Write a short bio (optional, max 300 chars). Send 'skip' to skip:
reg_interests: Enter your interests, comma-separated (optional, max 15). Send 'skip' to skip:
reg_complete:
🎉 Registration complete!

You can now start chatting by finding a partner.
search_started:
🔍 Searching for a partner...

Please wait, it may take a few seconds depending on your criteria.
search_no_partner:
😐 No suitable partner found right now.

You've been added to the queue. We'll notify you when someone is available.
search_matched:
🎉 Partner found!

💬 You can now start chatting. Your messages are relayed anonymously.

Use the buttons to end the chat.
search_partner_connected:
🔔 An anonymous user wants to chat with you!

💬 Chat started. Enjoy!
chat_ended:
👋 Chat ended.

Hope you had a good experience!
chat_partner_ended:
👋 Your partner left the chat.

Find someone new with the button below.
report_filed: ✅ Your report has been filed. Our team will review it.
profile_edit_what: What would you like to edit?
daily_reward_already: ✅ You already claimed your daily reward today.
achievements_empty: You haven't earned any achievements yet.
rate_limit_message: ⏳ You're sending messages too fast. Please slow down and try again.
flood_message: 🚫 Repeated message detected. Please avoid spamming.
maintenance_message:
🔧 The bot is under maintenance.

Please try again later.
help_text:
Saya is an anonymous chat bot.

📝 Register: Build your profile
🔍 Find a partner: Chat with a stranger
⚙️ Settings: Manage profile & privacy
👥 Invite friends: Get XP for invites
🏆 Achievements: Complete missions

During chat:
• Your messages are relayed anonymously
• Send text, photos, videos, voice and more
• Use 'End chat' button to finish

Security:
• Message content is never stored
• Anti-spam is active
• Report partners who misbehave
admin_only: ⛔ This command is for admins only.
admin_ban_prompt:
Enter user's Telegram ID and reason:
Example: 123456789 - ban reason
error_generic: ❌ An error occurred. Please try again.
error_not_registered: ❌ You need to register first. Start with /start.
error_already_in_chat: ❌ You're already in a chat. End it first.
anon_compose_intro:
📩 You are sending an anonymous message.

Send your message (text, photo, video, voice, etc.).
Your identity stays hidden.

Send /cancel to abort.
anon_rate_limited: ⏳ You cannot send more anonymous messages right now. Try later.
anon_reply_prompt:
💬 Write your reply:
(This will be sent anonymously to the sender)
anon_forward_prompt: 📥 Forward the anonymous message to a channel/group where the bot is admin:
anon_forward_failed: ❌ Forward failed. Make sure the bot is admin in that channel/group.
anon_not_admin: ⚠️ The bot must be admin in the channel/group to forward.
